description: This file defines types and functions for managing linked list data structures, including retrieval, insertion, deletion, and existence checks of nodes by key.

methods.name: export function listGetNode<T, K>(list: RootNode<T, K>, key: ListNode<T, K>['key'], isDelete?: b/ listGetNode
methods.description: Retrieves a node from the list by key; optionally deletes it if isDelete is true.

methods.name: listGet
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key from the list.

methods.name: listSet
methods.description: Sets (inserts or updates) the value for a given key in the list.

methods.name: listHas
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the list.

methods.name: listDelete
methods.description: Deletes a node by key from the list.
